title: Chapter 681 - 681 Chasing; Spatial Turbulence!

Chapter 681 - 681 Chasing; Spatial Turbulence!

Chapter 681 - 681 Chasing; Spatial Turbulence!

681 Chasing; Spatial Turbulence!

In the endless primordial chaos, two streaks of light, one white and one gold, pierced through the void and flew forward.

Meteorites, planets, buildings… Nothing could stop them.

At this moment, the golden stream of light suddenly accelerated and stopped in front of the white stream of light. It gradually condensed into a muscular middle-aged man holding a large saber.

“Tao Qian, you can’t escape!”

Upon hearing this, the white stream of light stopped and slowly condensed into a white-haired old man.

“Hey, didn’t I just take a few billion crystals from you and kill two of your guardians and two of your sons? Is there a need to chase after me like this?”

Spirit crystals were extremely pure energy crystals in the Chaosverse.

Generally speaking, a world could only produce one crystal in a year.

However, Tao Qian had taken billions of spirit crystals!

The middle-aged man had a total of six guardians and five sons.

Tao Qian had killed two guardians and two sons, so he had killed almost half of them!

In the end, Tao Qian said it so casually and indifferently.

The middle-aged man clenched the hilt of his saber tightly. The anger in his heart erupted like a volcano.

“Die!”

He drew his saber and swung it, shooting out boundless saber light.

Tao Qian’s figure flashed and easily moved to the side.

Not far away, an orange planet suffered an unexpected disaster and exploded like fireworks.

“Hey, you’re quite cool!” Tao Qian said.

A single slash had shattered a planet!

His strength… was so tyrannical!

Some of the people hidden in the primal chaos knew that they could not provoke the other party at all, so they quickly retreated like birds frightened by the twang of a bow.

…

After an unknown amount of time, Tao Qian, with a head full of flowery hair, appeared in the void.

“I finally got rid of him.

“Now, it’s time to see that little fellow who has mastered the power of time.”

Tao Qian muttered to himself as he closed his eyes to search for the location of Earth.

After a while, he frowned. “The space is in chaos? What’s going on?”

…

On the other hand, Lin Fan had already returned to Earth.

Even though Lin Fan had used the power of time to repair the door…

Earth was still attacked by some chaotic squalls. Earthquakes, tsunamis, volcanoes… A series of disasters caused many roads and houses to collapse and crack to varying degrees.

When Lin Fan returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, Hu Tian, Huang Ling, Qiu Ziqian, and the others quickly surrounded him.

“Lin Fan, are you alright?” they asked worriedly.

Lin Fan smiled. “Don’t worry, I’m fine.”

Hearing Lin Fan’s relaxed tone, everyone heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, Lin Fan explained the general situation.

When they heard about the monster, everyone’s hearts jumped to their throats.

When they heard that Lin Fan had killed the huge monster, their faces were filled with smiles and pride.

This was Lin Fan, their lover!

He could even kill terrifying monsters!

After that, the few of them ate and chatted together, laughing and laughing from time to time. They were very relaxed and happy.

However, this life did not last long before the entire world suddenly shook violently again.

The ground cracked and the rocks collapsed… It was extremely terrifying.

Lin Fan raised his brows. “I’ll go take a look.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he disappeared from where he was.

In the next moment, he appeared in front of the ancient door.

Lin Fan’s eyes were like lightning as he stared at the door.

Instantly, the thick door turned transparent in his eyes.

The scene outside the door fell into his eyes.

At this moment, two huge monsters had appeared outside the door.

Their eyes were like the sun as they stared at the door. Their eyes were filled with greed.

“What dense life force!”

“This is definitely a world with countless lives. Keke, my luck is not bad!”

“It must taste wonderful!”

…

As the two monsters spoke, they could not help but swallow their saliva.

While they were talking, another monster flew over.

“What a wonderful smell!”

“However, it seems to have an extraordinary defensive power. Let’s attack together and then devour it in pieces. What do you think?”

The other two monsters had already felt the powerful defense of the door.

They understood that it would be very difficult for them to break the door by themselves.

“Alright!”

“Agreed!”

Then, the three monsters either shot out energy beams, waved their claws, or rammed into the door.

Immediately, the entire earth shook violently again.

…

When Lin Fan saw this, his face turned serious.

That was because he could vaguely see other monsters rushing over from the depths of the endless chaos.

If this continued…

Even this ancient door would find it difficult to resist.

Just as Lin Fan was thinking of a plan, another three monsters arrived at the door.

At this moment, a hearty voice sounded in the endless void.

“Hahaha! So many Chaos Beasts!”

A sharp arrow shot out, sweeping up a terrifying spatial storm. It crushed all the monsters into pieces, leaving only a few light beads shining in the chaos.

At the same time, a huge spatial turbulence formed in the void, instantly engulfing the gateway and the entire Earth.

A moment later, a tall man wearing golden armor and holding a bow appeared.

With a wave of his hand, all the light beads in the air entered his hand.

“My luck is pretty good. I killed so many Chaos Beasts at once!

“There’s a good chance of winning this time!”

He sniffed and said, “There seemed to be a very pure life force here just now. Is it a world? Forget it, it’s useless. The competition is more important!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took a step forward and flew forward.

…

On the other hand, the door in the chaotic space was constantly being attacked.

Gradually, cracks appeared on the surface of the door.

The spatial turbulence was truly too terrifying.

At the same time, the entire earth shook continuously.

Mountains collapsed, the ground caved in, tsunamis came flooding… Countless disasters followed.

Screams and wails could be heard without end.

…

Lin Fan looked at the door. The cracks on it were getting denser and denser, as though the door was about to shatter at any moment. His face turned solemn.

Not long ago, Lin Fan had used the power of time once.

He had yet to fully recover.

He no longer had enough power to reverse time.

However, he still used everything he had to mobilize his strength.

He was prepared to forcefully reverse time again.

At this moment, a huge crack suddenly appeared in the chaotic space.

The ancient door and the entire Earth flew out through the crack.

At this point…

The spatial turbulence finally disappeared, and Earth finally regained its peace.
